body:
I'll make this a short but important warning.
I've loved every substance I've used except for xanax. Any thing from diphenhydramine, LSD, dilaudid, and dank, I've loved greatly.
However insufflating just 2mg of xannie changed my life for the worst.
I racked it at about 9pm waited till about 915 and passed out. I don't remember anything from the next day. YES, THE NEXT DAY. I was so screwed up on the stuff, I came stumbling out of my room, fell down the stairs, and scared the living shit out of my mom.
I spent the whole day home from school vomiting profusely and convulsing. I apparently had some bad reaction with the chemical.  It sure fucked me up badly.
